title: The impact of phase modification on the equilibrium and kinetics of lanthanide(III) extraction from nitric acid media by TODGA
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43941-43954
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06417A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wyatt S. Nobley, Mark P. Jensen
Implementing DHOA and TBP as phase modifiers in the extraction of Nd(III) by TODGA leads to vastly different effects. TBP alters the bulk equilibrium complexation and the mass transfer mechanism while DHOA does not.
